tier_reason: The README shows first-party benchcmp tables comparing the AVX2, AVX and SSE assembly paths against the package's own pure-Go path (AVX2 is 3.94x at 128K on a Xeon E5-2620 v3). It also has a go test -bench=Comparison table against Go stdlib MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 (BLAKE2b 850.64 MB/s vs SHA-256 189.58 MB/s). The benchmark code is public (benchmarks_test.go) and the CPU is named, but the Go toolchain version and flags are not stated, so this is C, not A.

corrections.baseline: The package's own pure-Go BLAKE2b fallback (compress_generic.go, derived from dchest/blake2b), labelled 'go.txt' in the benchcmp output. Also compared against Go stdlib crypto/md5, crypto/sha1, crypto/sha256 and crypto/sha512.
corrections.claimed_speedup: AVX2 is 3.94x faster than the pure-Go path at 128K (233.37 -> 918.93 MB/s); the README calls this 'roughly 4X ... approaching 1GB/sec on a single core'. AVX is 3.28x and SSE 2.85x at 128K, on a MacBook Pro i7. In the comparison benchmark, BLAKE2b-simd runs at 850.64 MB/s vs stdlib SHA-256 at 189.58 MB/s (~4.5x, derived from page data), SHA-512 at 306.33 MB/s and MD5 at 607.48 MB/s.
corrections.workload: Size benchmarks hash 64B-128KB buffers on one core on amd64 (AVX2/AVX/SSE assembly vs the pure-Go path). The stdlib comparison benchmark hashes 1 MiB messages, written in 1 KiB chunks.
corrections.caveats: Benchmarks compare only against the package's own pure-Go fallback and Go's stdlib hashes, not against OpenSSL or libb2 BLAKE2b. The stdlib SHA-256 baseline is from the 2016-era Go, before SHA-NI support, so its ratio is inflated compared with modern hardware or toolchains. The repo is archived by GitHub and the last commit on master is 2016-07-23 (pushed_at 2017-11-27). The Go compiler version is not stated for the benchmarks (CI tested Go 1.5/1.6). README benchmark names (BenchmarkHash*) differ from the current test file (BenchmarkSize*). All numbers are first-party.

notes: The claimed numbers match the README exactly. The only real metadata fix is last_commit: the commits API gives 2016-07-23, and 2017-11-27 is the repo's pushed_at. The repo is Apache-2.0, archived, not a fork, with 255 stars.
